answer: Admission is a recorded deed: a verifier called RecorderGate pulls the parcel number from the county recorder index, matches the grantor signature to the notarized chain of title, and refuses any parcel already bound to a seat. The penalty trigger is a duplicate parcel claim or one grantor deeding over four parcels in a quarter, which burns both bonds and files a lien. Title search costs two hundred fifty dollars, recording sixty, so N fakes cost N times three hundred ten dollars plus N surveys. A garden plot on a knoll needs a real ferrous corner stake, and no script stakes one twice.
